effect_description_eng:
[Your Turn] When this Tamer suspends, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a yellow Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If you have a yellow Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name, for the turn, 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s is also treated as a 6000 DP Digimon, gains ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and can't digivolve. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
